assets.value: A small family law and estate planning practice that explains your options plainly before you decide anything.

We handle family law, wills, and small estate planning for people who have never needed a lawyer before and don't want to feel talked down to. Every first meeting is a real conversation, not a sales pitch -- we tell you honestly whether you need us at all, and what it will actually cost if you do. No hourly surprises: every case gets a flat fee, agreed in writing, before any work starts.
